reviews.author: Oh Dong-jin
reviews.text:
I purchased sandals worth 45,000 won in January 2025. Actually, I felt it was expensive, but I bought it anyway. But less than two months later, both sides were torn. So I visited the store and they replaced it with new shoes. I wore some for 2 months, so instead of just accepting it, I gave them 20,000 won.

But the next morning, the sandals I replaced were all torn. I got angry and went back to the store. The boss just says it's not his fault, it's the defective shoes. Even when I asked for a refund, they replaced it with new sandals and exchanged the additional 20,000 won I paid for slippers instead of money.

I wanted to fight more with the boss, but I stopped because I didn't know if I had to go this far for 6,5000 won.

This is truly a store I never want to go to again.

I think everyone but the boss knows that business is not going well.
